info.title: Runware API - FLUX 3 Image
info.summary: Native 4K image generation and editing with precise multi-reference control
info.description: FLUX 3 Image is Black Forest Labs' image generation and editing model built on the multimodal FLUX 3 backbone shared with FLUX 3 Video. It combines text-to-image synthesis, precise local editing, multi-reference composition, bounding-box placement, and native 4K output. The model preserves identities and fine details across references, supports targeted changes and in-place text editing, and renders accurate typography in text-heavy layouts across a broad range of visual styles.

AuthenticationTask.title: Authentication
AuthenticationTask.description: Authenticates a connection using an API key. Can be sent as the first element of the request array as an alternative to using the Authorization header.

taskType.title: Task Type
taskType.description: Identifier for the type of task being performed.

connectionSessionUUID.title: Connection Session UUID
connectionSessionUUID.description: Optional session UUID to resume a previous connection and receive any buffered results.

model.title: Model
model.description: Identifier of the model to use for generation.

referenceImages.title: Reference Images
referenceImages.description: List of reference images (UUID, URL, Data URI, or Base64).

items.title: Image
items.description: Image input (UUID, URL, Data URI, or Base64).

positivePrompt.title: Positive Prompt
positivePrompt.description: Text prompt describing elements to include in the generated output.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of the generated media in pixels.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of the generated media in pixels.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution preset for the output. When used with input media, automatically matches the aspect ratio from the input.

boundingBoxes.title: Bounding Boxes
boundingBoxes.description: Regions that place, move, resize or remove elements.

id.title: ID
id.description: Region identifier, unique within the request. Referenced from `positivePrompt` as `<id>`.

referenceIndex.title: Reference Index
referenceIndex.description: Index into `inputs.referenceImages` the element is taken from. Null for a new element.

sourceBox.title: Source Box
sourceBox.description: Position of the element inside the reference as [top, left, bottom, right] on a 0 to 1000 scale. Matching `sourceBox` and `targetBox` keep the element in place, different values move or resize it. Null for a new element.

targetBox.title: Target Box
targetBox.description: Position in the output as [top, left, bottom, right] on a 0 to 1000 scale, whatever the output size. Top must be lower than bottom and left lower than right. Null removes the element, which requires reference images.

safetyTolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safetyTolerance.description: Tolerance level for content moderation. Lower values are stricter; higher values are more permissive.

taskType.title: Task Type
taskType.description: Identifier for the type of task being performed.

taskUUID.title: Task UUID
taskUUID.description: UUID v4 identifier for tracking tasks and matching async responses. Must be unique per task.

webhookURL.title: Webhook URL
webhookURL.description: Webhook URL that receives JSON responses via HTTP POST when generation tasks complete. For batch requests with multiple results, each completed item triggers a separate webhook call as it becomes available.

includeCost.title: Include Cost
includeCost.description: Include task cost in the response.

numberResults.title: Number of Results
numberResults.description: Number of results to generate. Each result uses a different seed, producing variations of the same parameters.

uploadEndpoint.title: Upload Endpoint
uploadEndpoint.description:
Specifies a URL where the generated content will be automatically uploaded using the HTTP PUT method. The raw binary data of the media file is sent directly as the request body. For secure uploads to cloud storage, use presigned URLs that include temporary authentication credentials.

**Common use cases:**

- **Cloud storage**: Upload directly to S3 buckets, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage using presigned URLs.
- **CDN integration**: Upload to content delivery networks for immediate distribution.

```text
// S3 presigned URL for secure upload
https://your-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/generated/content.mp4?X-Amz-Signature=abc123&X-Amz-Expires=3600

// Google Cloud Storage presigned URL
https://storage.googleapis.com/your-bucket/content.jpg?X-Goog-Signature=xyz789

// Custom storage endpoint
https://storage.example.com/uploads/generated-image.jpg
```

The content data will be sent as the request body to the specified URL when generation is complete.

[Read full documentation](https://runware.ai/docs/models/bfl-flux-3-image#uploadEndpoint)

ttl.title: TTL
ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for generated content. Only applies when `outputType` is `URL`.

outputFormat.title: Output Format
outputFormat.description:
Specifies the file format of the generated output. The available values depend on the task type and the specific model's capabilities.

- \`JPG\`: Best for photorealistic images with smaller file sizes (no transparency).
- \`PNG\`: Lossless compression, supports high quality and transparency (alpha channel).
- \`WEBP\`: Modern format providing superior compression and transparency support.
- \`MP4\`: Widely supported video container (H.264), recommended for general use.
- \`WEBM\`: Optimized for web delivery.
- \`MOV\`: QuickTime format, common in professional workflows (Apple ecosystem).
- \`GIF\`: Animated image format (no audio), suitable for short loops or previews.
- \`MP3\`: Compressed audio, smaller file size.
- \`WAV\`: Uncompressed, high-quality audio.
- \`FLAC\`: Lossless compression.
- \`OGG\`: Open-source compressed audio format (Vorbis codec).
- \`SVG\`: Scalable Vector Graphics.
- \`TIFF\`: High-quality output supporting layers.
- \`GLB\`: Binary glTF format for 3D models, including geometry, textures, and PBR materials.

> [!NOTE]
> \*\*Transparency\*\*: If you are using features like background removal or LayerDiffuse that require transparency, you must select a format that supports an alpha channel (e.g., \`PNG\`, \`WEBP\`, \`TIFF\`). \`JPG\` does not support transparency.

[Read full documentation](https://runware.ai/docs/models/bfl-flux-3-image#outputFormat)

outputQuality.title: Output Quality
outputQuality.description: Compression quality of the output. Higher values preserve quality but increase file size.

deliveryMethod.title: Delivery Method
deliveryMethod.description: Determines how the API delivers task results.

oneOf.description: Returns complete results directly in the API response.
Returns an immediate acknowledgment with the task UUID. Poll for results using getResponse.

safety.title: Safety Settings
safety.description: Content safety checking configuration for image generation.

checkContent.title: Check Content
checkContent.description: Enable or disable content safety checking. Increases total generation time.

watermark.title: Watermark

image.title: Watermark Image
image.description: Watermark image (UUID, URL, Data URI, or Base64).

RequestBody.description: You must always POST an array of task objects.

taskType.title: Task Type
taskType.description: Identifier for the type of task this response belongs to.

taskUUID.title: Task UUID
taskUUID.description: UUID v4 identifier echoed from the original request, used to match async responses to their tasks.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Task cost in USD. Present when `includeCost` is set to `true` in the request.

imageDataURI.title: Image Data URI
imageDataURI.description: Data URI of the output image.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed used for generation. If none was provided, shows the randomly generated seed.

NSFWContent.title: NSFW Content
NSFWContent.description: Flag indicating if NSFW content was detected.

ErrorResponse.title: Error Response
ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned by the Runware API.

code.description: A short identifier for the error (e.g., invalidApiKey, timeoutProvider).

message.description: A human-readable explanation of what went wrong.

parameter.description: The request parameter related to the error, if applicable.

taskType.description: The task type of the request that failed.

taskUUID.description: The unique identifier of the failed request.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing or invalid parameters.

401.description: Unauthorized — No valid API key provided.

403.description: Forbidden — The API key lacks permissions for this request.
